content:
Hello all!

I'm a retired veteran software engineer, who is just having fun working on what I want to work on (for once :). I've always had a soft spot in my heart for formal logic and theorem provers and this is looking very interesting to me. I am fluent in lots of languages including functional languages like Haskell and Scheme, but am not familiar with Lean. So I'll start by doing stuff to get used to the environment. I'm an experienced and pretty good code reviewer, so in the long term I could help with that if needed.
